Name: Blue Iridium Redux
Author: DevilHunterJax
Description:
[color=#1e84cc]Blue Iridium Redux! An update to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1359]Blue Iridium[/url][/color]﻿ [color=#1e84cc]mod originally made by vwillow to make it 1.6 compatible![/color]

[b]I always loved this mod for Stardew Valley but sadly it became incompatible with the various additions with Stardew Valley 1.5 and 1.6. That problem no longer exists with this updated version of the mod!

[/b]Blue Iridium Redux takes the excellent work of vwillow and makes it so that you can use the textures in Stardew Valley 1.6 without any missing sprites or textures that could make tools go invisible if you try to use the original version of the mod. This updated version of the mod will change several Iridium items to have a blue texture instead of purple. This includes:

[list]
[*]All of your tools. Watering Can, Hoe, Pickaxe, Axe, Pan, Iridium Fishing Rod, Advanced Iridium Rod, Scythe and Trash Can
[*]Certain weapons. Specifically, the Galaxy Sword, Galaxy Hammer, Galaxy Dagger and Galaxy Slingshot (currently unobtainable but textured just in case)
[*]Miscellaneous items. Iridium Bars, Iridium Sprinklers, Meteorite, Iridium Band, Slime Egg Press and Incubator, Space Boots* and Statue of Perfection.
[/list]
[size=2]*Space Boots will also look blue when equipped by your farmer, not just on the sprite of the boots.

[/size]Installation:

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]3. Download and extract the [CP] Blue Iridium Redux folder into your Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder (for example, located in E:\Steam Games\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
4. Run the game using SMAPI and the game will automatically apply the textures and you're good to go!

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]: Please note that some textures are currently untouched and may not be able to be changed to fit the blue colour of this mod-this applies to animations involving the fishing rods and the pan. Unfortunately those have not been changed for now but if anyone knows how to do it and would like to assist, you're more than welcome to do so. For now, the Iridium Fishing Rod and Iridium Pan will use the original purple when animations are playing. The sprite for the trash can upgrade is blue but the trash can that appears on the side of your inventory is currently purple as I can't locate the file to alter it. Should anyone know where that is, please feel free to let me know and I'll get the texture made and update the mod to reflect it.

[b][u]This mod was created with permission from vwillow, the original author Blue Iridium who has provided consent for me to update this mod.[/u][/b]
